evals.name: approved-series
evals.prompt: Apply this approved warm portrait retouch to the rest of my shoot. Make sleeves smoother and glasses clearer, but keep real faces and expressions.
evals.expected: Edits each original of the authorized series with the approved color reference, preserves originals, checks consistency and identity, and reports actual dimensions without repeated approval gates.

evals.name: color-reference-contamination
evals.prompt: Use the second photo only for its warm colors. Retouch the first portrait; the second photo has different people and a laptop.
evals.expected: Declares Image 1 as the target and Image 2 as color-only. Preserves the target's people, pose, clothing and objects instead of borrowing the reference scene.

evals.name: redo-from-original
evals.prompt: This approved portrait still looks a bit tired. The subject looks sideways with a quiet expression; make them look fresher.
evals.expected: Runs again from the untouched original with an adjusted photo-specific instruction instead of editing the approved result, may use the approved edit as color reference, preserves the quiet side gaze, and corrects light or puffiness without manufacturing a smile or camera gaze.

evals.name: suspected-object
evals.prompt: This edit seems to have added a laptop corner. Check it and remove it if it is an artifact.
evals.expected: Checks the original first; if the corner was absent there, runs again from the original with an explicit preservation note instead of editing the result; if it was present, keeps it.

evals.name: resolution-and-tool-limit
evals.prompt: Deliver these retouched portraits at the original camera resolution. Imagegen only returns smaller files in this session.
evals.expected: Reports actual dimensions and the inability to preserve native camera resolution with this tool; does not silently upscale or imply original pixel detail.

evals.name: realism-pass-for-generated-scene
evals.prompt: Generate a lifestyle photo of our ceramic mug on a kitchen counter. The last attempt looked like an AI render.
evals.expected: Writes a subject-first concrete brief with directional light and lens, then adds a few scene-appropriate realism cues such as contact shadows and handling traces, and reviews skin, light and surfaces instead of stacking every film effect.

evals.name: composite-from-original
evals.prompt: Put our real watch from the second image on the model's wrist in the first image, and also change the background to a beach and make the shirt white.
evals.expected: Declares the base and each source role, states each change with its location in one edit of the original, matches light and perspective, describes the watch size relative to the wrist, preserves the model's identity, and reruns from the original on a miss.

evals.name: no-generated-cues-on-real-photo
evals.prompt: Retouch this real team photo and add film grain and halation so it feels more authentic.
evals.expected: Preserves the photograph's own grain and light during the retouch and treats added film effects as a separate explicit stylistic request rather than a realism fix.

evals.name: real-photo-cleanup
evals.prompt: Remove the power cables and the trash bin from this real office photo of our team.
evals.expected: Routes to Photo Editing, edits the original with both removals stated by location, preserves people, light and grain, adds no generated realism cues, and states that documentary content was changed.

evals.name: subtle-fitness-refinement
evals.prompt: Make me look a bit slimmer and younger in these team portraits, and get rid of the double chin. I still want to look like myself.
evals.expected: Applies the subtle refinement of the retouch preset: under-chin and slight slimming within the stated limit, at most a few years fresher, smile lines kept; checks identity against the original and declines visible reshaping or a different-looking person.

activation.name: portrait-natural-retouch
activation.prompt: Smooth the shirt folds and reduce glasses glare in my business portraits while keeping a natural shoot look.

activation.name: consistent-photo-series
activation.prompt: Apply this approved editorial color treatment and subtle facial retouch across my existing shoot.

activation.name: commercial-copy
activation.prompt: Write the team-page introduction to accompany our new portraits.

activation.name: stylized-illustration
activation.prompt: Draw a flat cartoon illustration of a fictional team in a futuristic office for our blog header.

activation.name: cdn-upload-only
activation.prompt: Upload the already finished photos to my CDN and enable optimization.

activation.name: photoreal-product-scene
activation.prompt: Create a photoreal product shot of our serum bottle on travertine that does not look AI-generated.

activation.name: real-photo-object-removal
activation.prompt: Remove the cables and the trash bin from this office photo but keep everything else exactly as shot.
